title: Two New Papers on Arabic Morphological Analysis Published
summary: Our latest benchmarks on domain sensitivity in Arabic morphological analyzers and the NoorGhateh corpus have been published in the Journal of Open Humanities Data.

title: New Paper on Knowledge Graph Link Prediction in ESWA
summary: Najmeh Torabian et al. proposed an unsupervised candidate re-ranking method with BGE sentence embeddings for knowledge graph link prediction, accepted in Expert Systems with Applications.

title: PersianMHQA Published in ACM TALIP
summary: Our paper introducing PersianMHQA, the first large-scale multi-hop open domain Persian QA dataset, has been published in ACM Transactions on Asian and Low-Resource Language Information Processing.

title: FAIR-RAG & FARSIQA Frameworks Announced
summary: Mohammad Aghajani Asl and Prof. Minaei introduced FAIR-RAG, an iterative adaptive refinement framework that guarantees faithfulness and removes hallucinations in retrieval-augmented generation.

title: Rezwan: 1.2M Record Corpus for Hadith NLP Released
summary: Rezwan, our LLM-powered corpus for classical texts with entity links and chain-of-narration annotations, has been released to the research community.
